own_summary.heading: Summary of investigations and key findings

sentences.text: IBAC examined procurement corruption in Victorian councils through Operations Dorset and Royston, drawing also on other investigations.
sentences.support: two investigations by IBAC into allegations of corrupt conduct involving procurement in the Victorian local government sector

sentences.text: The investigations concerned procurement and conflicts of interest at Darebin City Council and the City of Ballarat Council.
sentences.support: subverted procurement processes and failed to declare and manage conflicts of interest

sentences.text: IBAC found that a Darebin project manager helped an associate gain financially and that a Ballarat manager unlawfully authorised payments and obtained benefits.
sentences.support: IBAC found the project manager played a critical role in an associate obtaining a large financial advantage

sentences.text: It made two recommendations for the councils to strengthen procurement controls and for Local Government Victoria to consider a supplier code of conduct.
sentences.support: Local Government Victoria consider the development of a code of conduct for suppliers to Victorian councils

findings.quote: IBAC found the project manager played a critical role in an associate obtaining a large financial advantage from the council.
IBAC found that over a two-year period, Mr Carey unlawfully authorised payments totalling $184,123 and that he obtained $103,630 in benefits by way of direct pecuniary interest or secret commissions.

notes: The summary uses roles rather than names and does not expand on reported criminal proceedings. Two numbered recommendations are made in this report.
